none: PAS CAM-E4B381: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine: VRBS ROMA. Mint is uncertain, AD330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads VRBS ROMA. Reverse shows wolf and twins. Reverse legend - . Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.06g, diameter is 17mm
